observed_problem: The Quality Review Bundle stores research_profile/publication_profile labels but is not bound to the authoritative Production Profile. build_bundle infers WEEKLY from a Weekly issue ID and otherwise defaults to THEMATIC/LONGFORM_SPECIAL when callers omit explicit profile arguments. A RETROSPECTIVE_PERIOD issue can therefore silently receive the Thematic quality family, omitting Period-specific checks; callers can also explicitly supply a profile pair that does not match the edition Profile. Publication Candidate validation does not currently reject a quality bundle whose publication_profile differs from the candidate's publication_profile.
expected_behavior: Quality applicability must derive from and bind the exact Production Profile, never from issue-ID heuristics or caller-declared labels. The Quality Bundle must preserve the exact Profile authority and its research/publication identities. Publication Candidate validation must require the coupled Quality Bundle to match the Candidate/edition publication profile.

provenance.human_review_reference: Post-change five-perspective audit requested by Owner, 2026-08-22

improvement_action: Bind Quality Review Bundles to the exact Production Profile, derive applicable quality checks from that Profile, remove unsafe non-Weekly inference, require Publication Candidate/Profile consistency, and add Retrospective Period regressions.
